action: FINAL_EVIDENCE_REVIEW: Phase 06B Optional Cloud Rewrite Engine, scoped strictly to whether the implementation and evidence justify presenting the work to the user for review under status IMPLEMENTED_AWAITING_USER_REVIEW. This verdict does not close the phase and does not constitute or infer user acceptance.
reason: All five plan-judge conditions are honored with evidence rather than narrative: observability is operational-only (RewriteTelemetry carries provider, duration, fallback, and cause; a reflection test asserts no string field; the wired default sink is NullRewriteObservabilitySink); no new NuGet dependency was added by this phase; enable/consent state is explicitly session-only and BuildRewriteContext AND-combines all four gate conditions with no other path to Cloud; ADR-0005 is Accepted with a dated changelog referencing the plan verdict; and closure is not claimed, with project-state.md set to PHASE_06B_IMPLEMENTED_AWAITING_USER_REVIEW and a Next Action instructing that the user's explicit review be obtained. Local mode remains the unchanged default: the orchestrator computes the local result first and returns it unconditionally whenever the gate is unsatisfied. Desktop secret-freedom and provider indirection hold: the transport talks only to the backend, and the Gemini key and model are read solely from server configuration and sent via header rather than query string, fixing the originally found log-leak defect. DeepSeek is verifiably inert on the Desktop tier and corroborated as disabled on the backend tier by the contract verification block, the focused review, and a passing dedicated non-invocation test. The previously BLOCKING defect, where a validator exception could destroy the dictation, is genuinely repaired: the provider call and validation now sit inside one guard mapping any non-cancellation exception to the exact local text, with a dedicated regression test. The sensitive-token regex is confirmed corrected for Windows and UNC paths, a single non-overlapping Unix-path quantifier, and scheme and dotted-identifier coverage. Backend Program.cs confirms scoped DI, a singleton authenticator only, RemoveAllLoggers on the typed Gemini client, and a per-caller partitioned rate limiter. The accepted residual items are proportionate to a phase whose contract excludes deployment and live provider calls, and each is truthfully disclosed rather than concealed. One documentation-discipline defect was found: four documents still reported pre-second-repair-cycle figures while the verified evidence shows the final numbers. This required correction was applied before presentation.

requiredNextStep: Correct the stale test-count figures in project-state.md, risk-register.md, roadmap.md, and implementation-summary.md to the final verified numbers, citing dotnet-test.log as the source. Then present Phase 06B to the user exactly as IMPLEMENTED_AWAITING_USER_REVIEW, with no phase or task closure, no inferred acceptance, and no agent-relayed confirmation accepted as validation.
